component.name: Phlegethon
component.summary: Download videos, playlists and files from almost any website

description.p: Phlegethon is a download manager. Paste or drop links, review what was found, pick the quality, and download. Playlists and creator pages are listed first so you choose which items to keep. It uses yt-dlp for sites it knows, and falls back to scanning the page or downloading the file directly for sites it does not.
